name: Elisabeth Klotz
beschreibung: Hotel Elisabeth Klotz is located in the village of Nesselwängle, at the eastern end of the Tannheimer Tal. The surrounding mountain landscape and the nearby nature reserve Vilsalpsee shape the peaceful surroundings. The hotel has a wellness area with indoor pool and sauna as well as a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The hotel is family-run and caters to guests who want to use the hiking trails in summer and the ski area Neunerköpfe in winter. The furnishings combine traditional elements with modern amenities. The relaxed atmosphere is especially popular with active travelers and families.
